guideTitle: The Best USB-C Docking Stations for Everyday Desks
metaTitle: Best USB-C Docking Stations: Budget Hubs to HP Business Docks (2026)
metaDescription: We compared USB-C docking stations on display outputs, charging, ports and business features, from a $27 UGREEN hub to HP's G5 and 100W G6 docks.
introParagraphs: A USB-C dock lets one cable connect a laptop to monitors, peripherals and network. The main split is between inexpensive hubs that pass through your laptop charger's power and powered docks, like the HP G5 and G6 and Anker Prime, that supply their own and suit a permanent desk.

How many monitors you can run depends on the laptop's USB-C port, not just the dock's outputs; many laptops support fewer external displays than a hub offers, and some mirror rather than extend. Check your laptop's documentation.
Our comparison is based on published specifications and price position, not hands-on testing. Prices range from about $27 to $195 at the time of writing.

ugreen-7in1-revodok-pro.summary: An aluminum 7-in-1 hub with dual 4K 60Hz HDMI, 10Gbps data and 100W pass-through.
ugreen-7in1-revodok-pro.description:
The UGREEN Revodok Pro 7-in-1 is the lowest-priced dock here at about $27 at the time of writing: two HDMI outputs listed for 4K 60Hz, 10Gbps data ports and 100W pass-through in an aluminum body.

It has no Ethernet or card reader.
ugreen-7in1-revodok-pro.skipIf: You need Ethernet; the Anker 8-in-1 has it.

anker-laptop-docking-station-8in1.summary: An 8-in-1 hub with two HDMI ports, gigabit Ethernet, 85W pass-through and SD.
anker-laptop-docking-station-8in1.description: The Anker 8-in-1 adds gigabit Ethernet and an SD slot to two HDMI outputs listed for dual 4K, with 85W pass-through, for about $54 at the time of writing.
anker-laptop-docking-station-8in1.skipIf: You do not need Ethernet; the UGREEN is cheaper.

acer-usb-c-docking-station-9in1.summary: An Acer 9-in-1 hub with two HDMI ports for about $35.
acer-usb-c-docking-station-9in1.description:
The Acer 9-in-1 offers two HDMI outputs in a compact hub for about $35 at the time of writing.

The listing does not detail power delivery, data speed or Ethernet, so check before buying.

anker-nano-laptop-docking-station-8in1.summary: A compact 8-in-1 with 4K HDMI, 10Gbps USB-C, SD/TF and 85W pass-through.
anker-nano-laptop-docking-station-8in1.description: The Anker Nano 8-in-1 packs 4K 60Hz HDMI, 10Gbps USB-C, two USB-A ports, an SD/TF reader and 85W pass-through into a small body, for about $30 at the time of writing.

anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.summary: A 14-port dock with up to 160W output, dual 4K and 10Gbps data.
anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.description:
The Anker Prime is the high-power option: 14 ports and up to 160W total output, which suits higher-wattage laptops that 85W hubs may not fully charge, with dual 4K and 10Gbps data.

It costs about $170 at the time of writing.
anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.skipIf: You have a light ultrabook; a hub is enough.

anker-nano-13in1-laptop-docking-station.summary: A 13-in-1 dock with 2 HDMI + DisplayPort and a detachable 6-in-1 travel hub.
anker-nano-13in1-laptop-docking-station.description:
The Anker Nano 13-in-1 supports three displays (two HDMI and one DisplayPort), with 10Gbps USB-C and up to 100W power delivery, plus a detachable 6-in-1 module for travel.

Three displays depend on your laptop.
anker-nano-13in1-laptop-docking-station.skipIf: You use two monitors or fewer.

hp-usb-c-dock-g5-11in1.summary: HP's powered 11-in-1 G5 dock with firmware update support.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5-11in1.description:
The HP USB-C Dock G5 is a powered 11-in-1 business dock that works with USB-C laptops beyond HP's own, with firmware update support, for about $98 at the time of writing.

It sits between the consumer hubs and the Anker Prime in price.
hp-usb-c-dock-g5-11in1.skipIf: You want the most charging power; the G6 lists 100W.

hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.badge: Best HP Dock for Higher-Wattage Laptops
hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.summary: HP's current-generation G6 dock with 100W power delivery.
hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.description:
The HP G6 is HP's current business dock with 100W power delivery, suited to higher-wattage business laptops, with firmware update support.

It costs about $195 at the time of writing, about twice the G5. Other port details are not listed here.
hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.bestFor: HP business fleets and higher-wattage laptops.
hp-usb-c-100w-g6-dock.skipIf: The G5 meets your needs for half the price.

faq.q: Will a USB-C dock charge my laptop?
faq.a: Powered docks do; hubs pass through your charger's power up to their rated wattage.

faq.q: Why does my second monitor mirror?
faq.a: Some laptops cannot extend to multiple displays over one USB-C port. Check your laptop's documentation.

faq.q: Is an HP dock only for HP laptops?
faq.a: HP lists the G5 as compatible with USB-C laptops broadly, though some features are designed around HP business laptops.

bottomLine: For most desks, the UGREEN 7-in-1 is the budget choice, the Anker 8-in-1 adds Ethernet, and the Anker Nano 13-in-1 handles three displays.
For a permanent business desk, the HP G5 is the sensible powered dock and the G6 adds 100W; the Anker Prime suits power-hungry laptops with many peripherals.
